feeds.title: Ecumenical News
feeds.description: As a trusted source of information, Ecumenical News provides comprehensive coverage of ecumenical topics and developments worldwide. From news articles and interviews to analysis and commentary, readers can expect a diverse range of content that explores the efforts towards Christian unity and interfaith dialogue.

feeds.title: NFTU
feeds.description: NFTU (Notes From the Underground) is a volunteer online news reporting service which, since 2004, has dealt with news and information about True (Traditional) Orthodox jurisdictions throughout the world as well as reporting on Ecumenism, the most prevalent and dangerous condemned heresy of the 20th century.True Orthodox and Ecumenical News

feeds.title: Juicy Ecumenism Blog
feeds.description: The Juicy Ecumenism blog, maintained by the Institute on Religion and Democracy, examines the intersection of faith, politics, and culture from an ecumenical perspective. With a focus on engaging current issues, the blog explores the challenges and opportunities for Christian unity in today's world.

feeds.title: Ecumenical Retirement Community Blog
feeds.description: This blog focuses on the experiences and perspectives of residents, staff, and community members in an ecumenical retirement community. From stories of interfaith friendships to discussions on spiritual growth and community life, the blog offers insights into the unique dynamics of an ecumenical living environment.

feeds.title: PrayTellBlog » Ecumenism
feeds.description: PrayTellBlog, a platform for liturgical and theological discussions, features a section on ecumenism. The blog explores the intersection of worship, theology, and Christian unity, providing insights into the shared traditions and practices that can foster greater understanding and collaboration among different Christian communities.

feeds.title: Deji Okegbile's Blog » General and Ecumenism
feeds.description: Deji Okegbile, a Christian theologian and ecumenical advocate, shares his perspectives on general Christian topics and the importance of ecumenism in his blog. Readers can expect insightful reflections and theological discussions that emphasize the value of unity and collaboration among Christians.

feeds.title: Ecumenism in Canada
feeds.description: This blog focuses on ecumenical initiatives and developments within the Canadian context. From ecumenical worship services to collaborative projects among different Christian denominations, the blog highlights the efforts towards Christian unity in Canada.

feeds.title: Lighthouse Trails Research Project » Ecumenism
feeds.description: Lighthouse Trails Research Project is a Christian ministry that critically examines various movements and trends within the Church. Their blog section on ecumenism offers a critical analysis of ecumenical developments, highlighting potential theological concerns and implications for Christian orthodoxy.

feeds.title: Emmaus Ecumenical Catholic Community
feeds.description: The Emmaus Ecumenical Catholic Community is a faith community that embraces an inclusive and ecumenical approach to Catholicism. Their blog explores the intersections of Catholic faith, social justice, and ecumenical engagement, offering reflections on the shared values and aspirations of diverse Christian traditions.

feeds.title: North Thompson Ecumenical Shared Ministry
feeds.description: This blog focuses on the experiences and activities of the North Thompson Ecumenical Shared Ministry, a community that brings together different Christian denominations. The blog highlights the shared worship, fellowship, and service efforts of the community, reflecting the spirit of unity and collaboration.

feeds.title: Ecumenical Catholic Communion
feeds.description: The Ecumenical Catholic Communion is a faith community that seeks to bridge the divides among Christian traditions. Their blog provides insights into the unique perspective of ecumenical Catholics, exploring their approach to liturgy, theology, and collaboration with other Christian denominations.

feeds.title: The Ecumenism Blog
feeds.description: This blog offers a platform for scholars, theologians, and practitioners to share their insights and reflections on ecumenism. From theological reflections to practical resources for promoting Christian unity, the blog covers a wide range of topics that contribute to the understanding and advancement of ecumenical dialogue.

feeds.title: Ecumenical Women at the UN Blog
feeds.description: Ecumenical Women at the UN is a coalition of Christian organizations working towards gender justice and equality. Their blog sheds light on the intersection of faith, feminism, and advocacy at the United Nations, highlighting the efforts of Christian women in promoting social justice and gender equality.

feeds.title: Ecumenical Ministries of Oregon Blog
feeds.description: Ecumenical Ministries of Oregon is an organization dedicated to promoting unity and collaboration among Christian churches in Oregon. Their blog highlights the work of member churches, shares community events, and explores social justice issues from an ecumenical lens.

feeds.title: The Brethren Life & Thought Blog » Ecumenism
feeds.description: This blog, affiliated with the Church of the Brethren, explores the denomination's engagement with ecumenism. Reflecting on the Brethren's commitment to peace, justice, and dialogue, the blog examines the opportunities and challenges of building relationships with other Christian traditions.

feeds.title: Ecumenical Patriarchate Permanent Delegation to the World Council of Churches
feeds.description: The blog of the Ecumenical Patriarchate Permanent Delegation to the World Council of Churches offers insights into the Orthodox Church's engagement in ecumenical dialogue. From official statements and news updates to theological reflections, the blog provides a unique perspective on Orthodox ecumenism.

feeds.title: Gladys Ganiel Blog » Ecumenism
feeds.description: Gladys Ganiel, a sociologist and theologian, shares her insights on ecumenism in her blog. Drawing from her research and experiences in ecumenical movements, the blog offers thoughtful reflections on the challenges, achievements, and potential of Christian unity in contemporary society.

feeds.title: Holy Wisdom Monastery Blog
feeds.description: Join Benedictine sisters who welcome all to experience prayer, hospitality and ecumenical Christian community at Holy Wisdom Monastery, Madison, Wisconsin. At Holy Wisdom Monastery, our mission, vision and ministries are shaped by values drawn from the Rule of Benedict beauty, balance, simplicity, silence and respect for all of creation.

feeds.title: Commonweal Magazine » Ecumenism
feeds.description: Commonweal Magazine, a leading Catholic publication, features articles and essays on a wide range of topics, including ecumenism. The blog section explores the ecumenical landscape, reflecting on the challenges and possibilities of Christian unity in today's pluralistic society.
